blocks.text: ATLANTA — Atlanta Dream guard Allisha Gray has been ruled out of Game 2 of the WNBA semifinals Wednesday night because of a hand injury. Gray, a four-time All-Star and Atlanta’s leading scorer during the regular season, injured her left hand during the first quarter of Atlanta’s 92-82 Game 1 victory over the New York Liberty. She briefly returned to action after going to the locker room, but went down a second time after diving for a loose ball and did not return. “Allisha’s out tomorrow,” coach Karl Smesko said at his Tuesday media availability. “She had an appointment today and […]...
